description: This file contains a script for configuring and adding new models to a proxy server, involving user inputs to gather configuration parameters, and making HTTP POST requests to a specified endpoint.

methods.name: get_initial_config()
methods.description: Prompts user for proxy URL and master key, returns them.

methods.name: get_user_input()
methods.description: Prompts user for model configuration parameters and returns them as a dictionary.

methods.name: make_request(proxy_base_url, master_key, data)
methods.description: Constructs and sends a POST request to add a new model to the proxy server, then prints response status and text.

methods.name: main()
methods.description: Main control loop that collects config, adds models interactively until the user decides to stop.
